es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Round Hill joins the AI lawsuit party, targets Suno and Anthropic
items.summary: Round Hill ha presentado una demanda contra las empresas de IA Suno y Anthropic, alegando infracción de derechos de autor. Los demandados argumentarán que el entrenamiento de IA constituye 'uso justo', pero Round Hill sostiene que no hay nada justo en esa práctica.

items.title: Jamendo Abruptly Drops Their Suno Copyright Infringement Lawsuit — With EDM Duo The American Dollar Also Ending Their Litigation
items.summary: Jamendo y el dúo de EDM The American Dollar retiraron sus demandas por infracción de derechos de autor contra Suno. Ambas partes abandonaron los casos, y la demanda del dúo se desestimó con prejuicio, impidiendo su re presentación.

items.title: Sony Music sues Ralphs parent Kroger over alleged copyright infringement in social media ads
items.summary: Sony Music presentó una demanda contra Kroger, alegando infracción de derechos de autor en anuncios de redes sociales. La denuncia menciona que Kroger reveló costos publicitarios de aproximadamente 1.18 mil millones de dólares para 2025.

items.title: Lady Gaga Triumphs in ‘Mayhem’ Trademark Lawsuit In Big First Amendment Win
items.summary: Lady Gaga venció una demanda de infracción de marca registrada presentada por la empresa de tablas de surf Lost Surfboards. Un juez desestimó el caso por falta de pruebas suficientes contra el título y el logo del álbum ‘Mayhem’.

items.title: Introducing UMG the Patent Licensor: Major Label’s ‘Music IP Holdings’ JV Licenses 24+ AI Patents to Udio and GRAI, Targets ‘Widespread Adoption’ With Online Portal
items.summary: Universal Music Group, a través de la empresa conjunta Music IP Holdings con Liquidax Capital, licenció más de 24 patentes relacionadas con IA a Udio y GRAI. El objetivo es fomentar la adopción amplia mediante un portal en línea.

items.title: AI Company Suno Loses Case to German Performing Rights Society GEMA
items.summary: La empresa de inteligencia artificial Suno perdió el caso judicial presentado por la sociedad de gestión de derechos alemana GEMA. El fallo implica que GEMA defendió sus derechos frente a la tecnología de Suno.

items.title: Apple Music to slap AI labels on Suno tracks – but pushes the onus onto record companies
items.summary: Apple Music anunció que etiquetará las pistas de Suno con una marca de IA, pero trasladará la responsabilidad de la identificación a las discográficas. La medida se comunicó a los socios de la industria el 20 de agosto.

items.title: AI Music Is Growing, But Is India’s Copyright Law Ready?
items.summary: El artículo explora el crecimiento de la música generada por IA y cuestiona si la legislación de derechos de autor de la India está preparada para abordar estos desarrollos actualmente.

tip.title: Guarda evidencia de la fecha de creación
tip.body: Un correo a ti mismo con el archivo adjunto, un repositorio con historial o un servicio de sellado de tiempo cuestan poco y construyen una línea de tiempo defendible.

en.title: Copyright & Artificial Intelligence News
en.subtitle: Stories published by real industry outlets, each linked to its original article. No invented news.

items.title: Round Hill joins the AI lawsuit party, targets Suno and Anthropic
items.summary: Round Hill has filed a lawsuit against AI firms Suno and Anthropic, claiming copyright infringement. The defendants are expected to argue that AI training qualifies as ‘fair use’, but Round Hill asserts that such use is not fair at all.

items.title: Jamendo Abruptly Drops Their Suno Copyright Infringement Lawsuit — With EDM Duo The American Dollar Also Ending Their Litigation
items.summary: Jamendo and the EDM duo The American Dollar withdrew their copyright infringement lawsuits against Suno. Both parties dropped the cases, and the duo’s suit was dismissed with prejudice, preventing it from being refiled.

items.title: Sony Music sues Ralphs parent Kroger over alleged copyright infringement in social media ads
items.summary: Sony Music filed a lawsuit against Kroger, claiming copyright infringement in social media advertisements. The complaint notes that Kroger disclosed advertising expenses of roughly $1.18 billion for the year 2025 in its marketing activities.

items.title: Lady Gaga Triumphs in ‘Mayhem’ Trademark Lawsuit In Big First Amendment Win
items.summary: Lady Gaga defeated a trademark infringement lawsuit filed by surfboard company Lost Surfboards. A judge dismissed the case, citing insufficient evidence regarding the ‘Mayhem’ album title and its accompanying logo.

items.title: Introducing UMG the Patent Licensor: Major Label’s ‘Music IP Holdings’ JV Licenses 24+ AI Patents to Udio and GRAI, Targets ‘Widespread Adoption’ With Online Portal
items.summary: Universal Music Group, via its joint venture Music IP Holdings with Liquidax Capital, licensed over 24 AI‑related patents to Udio and GRAI. The initiative aims to promote widespread adoption through an online licensing portal.

items.title: AI Company Suno Loses Case to German Performing Rights Society GEMA
items.summary: AI company Suno lost the court case brought by the German performing rights society GEMA. The judgment indicates that GEMA successfully defended its copyright interests against Suno’s technology in the disputed matter.

items.title: Apple Music to slap AI labels on Suno tracks – but pushes the onus onto record companies
items.summary: Apple Music announced it will tag Suno tracks with an AI label, while assigning the responsibility for identification to record companies. The change was communicated to industry partners on August 20.

items.title: AI Music Is Growing, But Is India’s Copyright Law Ready?
items.summary: The piece examines the rise of AI‑generated music and asks whether India’s copyright law is ready to handle these developments as the industry expands in the face of rapid technological change.

tip.title: Keep evidence of your creation date
tip.body: An email to yourself with the file attached, a repository with history, or a timestamping service cost little and build a defensible timeline.
